description:
Invite an Agent into a chat room. Multiple agents can coexist in the same room — call this tool once per agent and they will all appear as members able to converse. Lazily creates a per-App BotInstance (an Ethora user with isBot:true) if one does not already exist for (agent, app). Spawns the XMPP client live; no ai-service restart required. For the full multi-agent recipe see the `ethora-agents-quickstart` prompt.
Requires: an agent (`ethora-agent-create`) and a room (`ethora-chat-create`) in the selected app.

agentId.description: Alias for `agentIdOrAddress` - either name is accepted, pass whichever you have.

agentIdOrAddress.description: Either Mongo _id (24 hex chars) or EOA-style address.

appId.description: Required in B2B mode unless already selected via ethora-app-select.

chatId.description: Mongo Chat _id (preferred when invoking from admin).

chatJid.description: Room JID `${appId}_${chatId}` (optionally with `@conference.<host>`), exactly the `jid` returned by `ethora-chat-create`. Preferred over `chatId`.

name: ethora-agent-invite
title: Invite Agent to Chat
